Samplecorp Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results

CAPITALTOWN, Aug. 5, 2026 -- Samplecorp, a fictional company used only in tests, reported results for the second quarter 2026.

Second quarter net sales increased over the prior year. Full-year guidance is below.

Samplecorp expects full year 2026 net sales of $20.0 billion to $21.0 billion.

Selected results (in millions, except per share amounts)
                                   Q2 2026     Q2 2025
Total revenues and other income    5,432       4,987
Diluted net income per common share $ 2.87     $ 2.12
Net income (loss) per share, other segment $ (0.45)   $ 0.10
